💬 Iran’s deterrence strategy adapts to evolving threats: Defense Ministry

📌 Tehran, IRNA – Defense Ministry spokesperson Brigadier General Reza Talaei-Nik says Iran’s deterrence strategy remains dynamic and active in response to the changing nature and patterns of warfare, noting that recent hybrid warfare differs significantly from previous conflicts.

Speaking at a meeting of the Islamic Propagation Coordination Council on Wednesday, Talaei-Nik said Iran’s Armed Forces have demonstrated their defensive capabilities during the 40-day War.
​
The official noted that the country’s strategic structures and the legacy of the Martyred Leader Ayatollah Seyyed Ali Khamenei have enabled the Armed Forces to respond decisively from the first day of the conflict.
​
Talaei-Nik identified four main sources of Iran’s strength: leadership, national unity, the capabilities of the Armed Forces, and the performance of the Islamic Republic system.
​
He added that the war has highlighted the importance of maintaining constant military readiness, relying on domestic capabilities, developing strategic technologies, and expanding public participation in national defense.
​
The spokesperson further described the spirit of sacrifice, faith and innovation among Iranian forces as key elements that contributed to the country’s resilience during the war.
